description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for user management, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting users, with role-based access control and activity logging.

methods.name: requireAdmin
methods.description: Middleware function to restrict access to admin users.

methods.name: GET /users
methods.description: Handler to list users, accessible only by admin.

methods.name: POST /users
methods.description: Handler to create a new user, accessible only by admin.

methods.name: GET /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to retrieve user details, accessible by admin or the user themselves.

methods.name: PUT /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to update user information, accessible by admin or the user themselves with restrictions.

methods.name: DELETE /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to delete a user, accessible only by admin.
